messages:
Sam: Quick sync — planning a coordinated deploy tonight for runtime v2.3.1 + API header contract change + router header-split + console telemetry update. Target quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Need explicit pin decisions and rollback owners.
Jules: ack. Which router change exactly? header-based shard key split or a variant swap?
Sam: Router will do a header-based split (feature flag). Traffic plan: 5% -> new runtime initially, after stability ramp to 30%. We'll pin runtime images on dedicated pools and pin API schema version. deploy-bot will run staged waves.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Planned sequence: runtime -> api -> router -> console. Canary 10m per wave. Monitors: mTLS errors, 5xx rate, 429s, p50/p95 latency. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR SLI budget breach.
Neha: Can we keep console flip until router is fully stable? Console relies on new header tags for event inference.
Sam: Yes — order is runtime (kv/warmup change) -> API (header contract) -> router (split) -> console toggle. Console toggle last.
Ryan: Clarify rollback steps: if router spike, pin traffic back to previous router variant and pause rollout. If issues persist, roll API back, then runtime. Who owns immediate rollback decision?
Jules: Platform owns runtime rollback (me + @Neha). API rollbacks are Ryan. Router rollback is @network team. Console rollback is me. We'll call it in this order unless HOTPIT says otherwise.
Sam: Release notes draft — call out: "KV cache warmup may add ~40-100ms on initial requests until warm pool warms. Recommend warmup replicas=10 to mitigate." Also note possible 429 behavior during canary ramp. We'll add customer-facing note for EU region.
Neha: Canary success criteria I'll configure: p95 < 250ms, 5xx < 0.1%, tokens/sec within ±10% of baseline. I'll add those monitors and alert thresholds in Console.
Sam: Pinning details for deploy config (example): `image: redwood/runtime:v2.3.1@sha256:abcd1234...` and `api_schema: api-v2026-03-21`. Ensure CI artifacts reference digests, not tags.
Ryan: I'll assemble a short rollback playbook (steps + runbook links + key contacts) and post link here before warmup.
Jules: :thumbsup: timeline looks good. I'll be oncall and available. @deploy-bot please kick warmup at 21:50 UTC so pools are ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Warmup scheduled 21:50 UTC. Canary start 22:00 UTC. Will post progress updates and notify #postmortem if anomalies detected.
Sam: Thanks team. If anyone observes regressions during canary ping here immediately. If thresholds tripped, call rollback and follow the playbook.
Neha: noted — I'll watch the new header tag counts and kv hit-rate during the first 15m.
Ryan: I'll post the playbook link in ~20m.
